purpose: read-only baseline for notifier-only daily email rollout

commit.message:
Recover unsettled external credits after corroborated fee and balance updates

Retain provisional external credits through lagged position observations. Restore their protected quantity only after attributable fee evidence and sufficient catch-up balance, preserving established owned entitlements and restart recovery.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Commit ownership projections atomically and retain acknowledged recovery credits

Bound foreign inventory adoption by observed external-flow capacity while owned credits remain. Recover unsettled credits when attributed fees and aggregate positions corroborate them, including corrections to provisional closures. Keep cycle changes, activity checkpoints and audits in one transaction with version checks.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Keep scheduled paper protection independent of source polling

Recheck completed observation continuity before extending readiness or delegating. Preserve the initial review failures and add timing regressions.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Scope persisted trade identity to venue and event time

Preserve originals while accepting provider IDs reused on another day or venue. Add bounded concurrent-index migration, atomic conflict-aware generic writes, cross-session regressions and a private rollback-only PostgreSQL fixture. No historical backfill or trading-risk changes.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Reduce recorder batch SQL construction overhead

Preserve paged atomic conflict and retry semantics; record the failed opening conditions and local throughput evidence. Production acceptance remains required.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Reserve prepared-cache headroom for known-key promotion bursts

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Notify current paper session outcomes without requiring a trade

Observe same-day frozen cohort controls and atomically enqueue deduplicated MISSED, BLOCKED or completion notices through the existing notifier. No historical replay, broker-state claim, trading-control changes or heavy report generation.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

fix: retry deferred end-of-day report persistence

Keep broker completion facts independent from report persistence acknowledgement. Retry a missing snapshot after contention or failure, including across restarts, without turning report admission contention into an execution-worker fault.
